segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Midday, noon.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Buổi trưa.] [EN: Afternoon.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Buổi chiều.] [EN: Sold out.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hết rồi.] [EN: Is there any left.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Còn không.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You met this word already, in telling time — at six o'clock is] [VI: lúc sáu giờ.] [EN: It means at a moment.] [VI_F: Lúc.] [EN: a high, rising tone. I wake up at six.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi dậy lúc sáu giờ.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To join two actions in time, use] [VI_F: Khi.] [EN: which means when, a flat tone. When I wake up, I eat breakfast.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Khi tôi dậy, tôi ăn sáng.] [EN: Say, when I wake up.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi dậy.] [EN: When I go home, I cook.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi về nhà, tôi nấu ăn.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. At, a moment.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Lúc.] [EN: When.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Khi.] [EN: At eight o'clock.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Lúc tám giờ.] [EN: When I wake up, I eat breakfast.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi dậy, tôi ăn sáng.] [EN: When I go home, I cook.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi về nhà, tôi nấu ăn.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Khi.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: When.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Lúc.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: At, a moment.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Khi nào anh về nhà?] [VI_M: Dạ, lúc năm giờ. Khi về nhà, tôi nấu ăn.] [VI_F: Vậy hả.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say at six o'clock.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Lúc sáu giờ.] [EN: Say, when I go home, I cook.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Khi tôi về nhà, tôi nấu ăn.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you learn casual, everyday questions. The preview word is] [VI: vậy] [EN: which softens a question, like saying so.]
